iti11:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti11:2.1: “Monks, one who has not fully known & fully understood aversion… delusion… anger… contempt, whose mind has not been cleansed of passion for it, has not abandoned it, is incapable of putting an end to stress.
iti11:2.2: But one who has fully known & fully understood aversion… delusion… anger… contempt, whose mind has been cleansed of passion for it and has abandoned it, is capable of putting an end to stress.
iti11:3.1: [The verses for these discourses are identical with those for §§2—5.]
